name: Narumi Asami
source:
She is divorced. She and her daughter are living with the protagonist's father through the power of hypnosis. She plans on getting remarried in the future to the protagonist's father.

She is a kind and optimistic woman.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/saiminkeikaku/chara.html]official site[/url]]
